title.narrative: Enhancing Zambia’s NDC Implementation (EZ-NDC)

description.narrative: The Action document falls under the EU's Annual Action Plan 2023. and their EU in Zambia Multi-Annual Indicative Program 2021 –2027. GGGI will support delivery under an indirect management agreement. with regards to the governance structure and implementation modalities. The support would be for further development of the iMRV system, some work on climate governance and NDC implementation and the development of a youth internship programme.
